1. BROADCAST ARCHITECTURE
================================================================================
- Self-hosted static audio syndication powered by podsync v2.8.0.
- Generates static RSS 2.0 XML feed (feed.xml) with zero tracking pixels, zero dynamic ad insertion, and direct audio enclosures.

================================================================================
2. EPISODE ARCHIVE (JUNE – JULY 2026)
================================================================================
[EPISODE 05] From Neural Compilers to Sovereign Browser AI
- Date: July 2026 | Duration: 15:47
- Topics: 1990s massively parallel neurocomputers (MetaNet, BSP400) compared to modern client-side WebGPU inference and local-first AI tooling.

[EPISODE 04] Deterministic Linguistics Meets Dense Vector Retrieval
- Date: July 2026 | Duration: 18:12
- Topics: Hybrid RAG architectures combining Part-of-Speech sequence filtering (PCT Patent WO 2014/003543 A1) with dense vector search.

[EPISODE 03] Against Subscription Lock-In: Building Sovereign Personal Infrastructure
- Date: June 2026 | Duration: 14:29
- Topics: First-principles Linux engineering, replacing opaque SaaS wrappers with auditable local software and static feeds.

[EPISODE 02] Human-Machine Partnership: Integrity Headers & Verifiable AI
- Date: June 2026 | Duration: 16:05
- Topics: Explicit provenance headers, zero silent fallbacks, and human verification gates in AI-assisted engineering.

[EPISODE 01] Pure Signal, Zero Static: Inaugural Broadcast
- Date: June 2026 | Duration: 12:40
- Topics: Founding manifesto of The Kleynenberg Perspective on signal-to-noise ratio in technical broadcasting.
